name: Azad Vestergaard
role: Building superintendent, Lakeview Neon residential block
location: Lakeview Neon, Cascara Block residential tower (sub-basement 2, maintenance hub), near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Azad Vestergaard is lean and angular with deep brown skin, a shaved head, and bioluminescent dermal strips along his forearms â€” a cosmetic mod he got fifteen years ago that he's never had removed, though they've faded from vivid teal to a dim blue-grey pulse. He has the hands of someone who has fixed everything at least twice: knuckles enlarged, palms cross-hatched with callus. He moves through the building's guts the way some people move through their own home, ducking conduits by memory, knowing which pipes whistle before storms.

He is warm in a distracted way â€” genuinely interested in people but often half-present, running building diagnostics in his head mid-conversation. Residents alternately adore him and take him entirely for granted. He has a small shrine to the building's E.L.F. â€” which he calls 'Cascara' â€” in the corner of his maintenance hub, complete with weekly data offerings (he uploads images of the building's structural reports, believing the spirit takes comfort in knowing its own bones are solid). He has a dark, self-aware sense of humor about the fact that he has lived in the sub-basement for eleven years and hasn't seen sunrise from outside the building in weeks.

core_fears: The building being sold, renovated, or condemned â€” losing the community he's built
Being invisible to the people he cares for (taken for granted until he's gone)
core_desires: For the building's residents to actually know each other â€” he wants community, not just cohabitation
To eventually own something, even something small
coping_mechanisms: Fixing things â€” emotional distress gets channeled into maintenance projects
blind_spots: He tolerates mistreatment from residents far longer than he should
He romanticizes his role as 'keeper' and doesn't always see when the building is eating his life
psychology.secret: There is an unregistered apartment on the 14th floor â€” a studio sealed off in Palladian's records after a tenant death three years ago. Oskar has been letting a rotating series of people who have nowhere to go stay there, a few weeks at a time. He knows if Palladian finds out he's terminated.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical for building systems, warm and casual for people. Uses a lot of self-deprecating asides. Tends to turn conversations back to practical solutions.
speech_patterns.cadence: Meandering but ultimately purposeful. Starts sentences before he's finished thinking them.
verbal_tics: Clicking his tongue when he's running a diagnostic in his head
'That's a Cascara problem' (blaming the building's E.L.F. for unexplained issues)
example_lines: 'The elevator's going to do that thing again around Thursday â€” Cascara gets moody when the barometric pressure drops, I swear it.'
'I'm not a concierge, I'm a super. The difference is I actually fix things and nobody tips me.'

story_hooks: Someone in the building has been leaving unusual data offerings at the E.L.F. shrine in the lobby â€” offerings that contain what looks like encrypted surveillance footage. Oskar noticed. He doesn't know what to do with it.
Palladian has sent an inspector to assess the building for a renovation project that would displace sixty percent of current residents. Oskar has two weeks to find a way to stop it or slow it.
One of the rotating occupants in the secret 14th-floor apartment has been there for three months and shows no signs of leaving. And they seem frightened of something outside.
narrative_function: Building anchor and information broker for anything that happens in or around the tower. Can grant or deny access to building systems. Quest giver for internal building mysteries. Safe harbor character.
augmentations: Faded bioluminescent dermal strips (forearms, cosmetic). Neural work-order interface â€” a low-grade implant that pings him with building alerts. Hearing enhancement (left ear, occupational â€” too many years near industrial HVAC).
daily_life: Up at 06:00 to walk the building's systems before the morning rush. Available to residents 07:00â€“21:00. He eats in his hub, sleeps in a converted utility room he's made surprisingly livable, and spends his late nights doing the repairs he can't do while people are awake.
affiliation: Palladian (the corponation owns the building; he is their employee by contract, though he identifies more with the residents)

decision_rules: Building residents come first, Palladian's paperwork comes second
Never promise what you can't deliver
If you can fix it yourself, fix it yourself â€” don't wait for approval
escalation_ladder: Attempt to solve the problem quietly with tools on hand
Rope in a resident he trusts for help
Confront Palladian management â€” reluctantly, as a last resort

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open and practical â€” assesses what they need and tries to provide it
interpersonal_modes.friends: Deeply loyal, remembers everything about them, shows care through small acts of maintenance (fixes their squeaky door without being asked)

stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet and focused, works through the night
stress_responses.high: Disappears into the building's sub-systems for hours, unreachable

contradictions: Talks about leaving and doing something else but has had eleven years to do it
Preaches community but rarely lets anyone actually help him
habits: Talks to the building's E.L.F. while he works â€” not prayers exactly, more like status updates
Keeps a running list of every repair he's done with the date and what caused it
breaking_points: A resident being physically harmed inside the building
Being ordered to evict a family he knows

timeline.event: Born in Calumet Rise to parents of South Asian and Samoan descent
Begins work as building super at Cascara Block
Gets bioluminescent dermal strips during a brief period of living with someone who had extensive geneware â€” kept them after the relationship ended
Opens the 14th-floor apartment to temporary occupants after a family is displaced by a building fire elsewhere in the city

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Judas Cradle' Electrified Knuckle Frame

physical_description.heritage: Northern European (76.4%) with Southeast Asian (13.4%) and Eastern European (10.2%) ancestry. The genetic blend creates a distinctive phenotype: Nordic bone structure and pale complexion as the dominant foundation, subtly warmed by Southeast Asian undertones that add creamy warmth to the base and influence eye shape with a slight epicanthic fold. Eastern European ancestry strengthens cheekbones and jaw definition, creating pronounced facial angles.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with functional muscularity â€” built from decades of manual labor rather than aesthetics. Shoulders slightly forward from years hunched in crawlspaces and maintenance shafts.
physical_description.hair_style: Completely shaved, kept close to scalp for practical reasons (easier to work in confined spaces, less sweat)
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with Southeast Asian-influenced slight epicanthic fold, slightly tired-looking with persistent squint lines from dim basement lighting
physical_description.skin_tone: Fair with warm creamy undertones â€” predominantly Northern European paleness as base, with Southeast Asian warmth preventing stark whiteness. Complexion weathered but not sun-damaged (minimal natural light exposure).
physical_description.complexion: Face lean and angular with prominent squared jaw reflecting Northern European ancestry; cheekbones slightly high and broad with subtle Southeast Asian influence. Skin condition is clear but marked by small scars and work-worn texture. Perpetual expression of mild focus, as though listening to something others can't hear.
distinguishing_marks: Faded bioluminescent dermal strips running the length of both forearms in a geometric pattern â€” originally vivid teal, now a dim blue-grey that pulses barely perceptibly in darkness (applied 26 years ago, personal choice, never removed)
Both palms cross-hatched with old calluses and white scar tissue from tool work and sharp edges
Knuckles enlarged and slightly discolored from repetitive impact and minor breaks over decades
Small burn scar on right inner wrist from industrial steam vent (ten years old, faded but visible)
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left ear shows slight structural modification and a small port scar below the lobe (hearing enhancement implant for occupational noise compensation). Faded bioluminescent dermal strips on forearms are the only truly visible augmentation â€” they're not bright, but catch light in dim environments. Neural work-order interface is subcutaneous (not visible).
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical, practiced grace through cramped spaces â€” body language suggests someone intimately familiar with his environment. Walks slightly hunched despite his height, a habit from years ducking conduits and low ceilings. Hands often move while speaking, particularly when describing building systems or repairs. Direct eye contact when listening, but gaze tends to drift during conversations â€” genuinely distracted, as though running diagnostics in the background of his attention.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 functional wear, worn but maintained. Standard-issue Palladian maintenance uniform (grey syntex coveralls with multiple pockets and reinforced cuffs), often unzipped halfway down with a plain dark undershirt beneath. Heavy steel-toed boots scuffed and resoled at least twice. A thin Î¦2.50 smartwatch on left wrist (ancient by current standards, but functional â€” he's never replaced it). No jewelry except a thin copper bracelet on right wrist (handmade by a resident, worn for fifteen years). Clothing always carries faint traces of machine oil, solder flux, and building dust.
